Keep the original helper and failed negative-control artifacts.

title: Two paper assertions omit their precise supporting anchors and ETF wording overstates the measured scope
owner: External draft successor, then data/pathways/ethylmalonyl-coa-pathway.yaml at approved integration
observed: emc-084 cites Results 2.3, Methods 4.1 and Table 1 for an assertion including two consecutive one-electron transfers to two ETF molecules. That explicit two-ETF statement is in Introduction section#sec1-molecules-23-00068/p[2], where it describes the ACAD-family mechanism with cited prior work; Results 2.3 observes ETF semiquinone formation and Mcd/ETF activity. The current record describes these as measured one-electron transfers. emc-105 cites sec3-3 and sec4/p[1], which support deletion effects, growth complementation and the failed binding experiment, but cellular PCC-activity complementation is in section#T1 under section#sec3-1.
rationale: The biological direction and regulation are supported, and this does not alter any pathway reaction. Precise source locations and observed-versus-inferred scope are required for traceability. The two-ETF microscopic interpretation should not be represented as a directly measured stoichiometric result of those Mcd assays.
proposed_action: Add the Introduction p2 anchor for the two-ETF ACAD mechanism, retain the Mcd Results 2.3 anchor, and state the two-ETF interpretation as the family mechanism consistent with observed Mcd semiquinone formation. Add the PCC Table 1/sec3-1 anchor and scope complementation to the measured growth/cellular PCC activity, without implying a measured rescued transcript response. Preserve all 14 reactions and formal whole-ETF Rhea states.
acceptance: Every revised selector resolves to the exact supporting native text/table.
ETF descriptions distinguish observed semiquinone production from the family-level microscopic mechanism; no direct 2-ETF stoichiometry claim without newly inspected evidence.
PccR complementation support locates Table1 (section#T1) and no direct DNA-binding/ligand claim is introduced.
Record still has 14 reactions, 50 chemical-side edges and all complete branches.
